common.id: Primary key, given by the database.
common.updatedAt: When the row was last changed.

values: Admin does everything. A Worker works by department.
A Worker must be `Sales` or `Factory`; the department decides the access.
Draft can be changed and deleted; Confirmed is locked and has one production order.
Not Started means quantity 0, Completed means the full quantity of the line.
Paid after one full payment, which also issues the receipt.
Moved by hand, one step forward. Received adds the stock once.
Add and Deduct move a lot by a quantity; Adjust is a signed correction and needs a reason.
What the file is. A new `PO_FILE` replaces the old one.
The table the file belongs to (with `ownerId`).
How the purchase order was paid.

User.purpose: A person who signs in: Admin, Sale Worker or Factory Worker.

columns.name: Display name.
columns.department: Department of the user; decides the access of a Worker.
columns.email: Sign-in name, stored in lower case. Unique.
columns.passwordHash: Hash of the password (bcrypt). The password itself is never stored.
columns.tokenVersion: Grows with every new password; a token with an older number is refused, so old sessions end.

Attachment.purpose: A file kept with a QT, a production order or a purchase order.

columns.ownerType: Table of the owner. There is no database key to it; the service checks it.
columns.fileType: Media type: PDF, PNG or JPG.
columns.filePath: Name of the stored file in the upload folder.

Customer.purpose: A company that buys from the factory.

columns.name: Company name.
columns.address: Postal address, printed on the QT, invoice and receipt.

Product.purpose: A product the factory makes and sells.

columns.name: Product name.
columns.price: Default unit price in yen; copied to a QT line and then editable there.

Material.purpose: A raw material or part kept in stock.

columns.name: Material name.
columns.minLevel: Minimum stock level. Empty means no level, so the material is never Low or Out.

ProductBom.purpose: Bill of materials: how much of a material one product needs. One row per product and material.

columns.productId: The product. The row goes with the product when it is deleted.
columns.quantity: Quantity of the material for one product.

MaterialLot.purpose: A lot of a material in stock. The total of the lots is the stock of the material.

columns.materialId: The material. The lot goes with the material when it is deleted.
columns.lotNumber: Lot number, unique inside the material.
columns.quantity: Quantity left in the lot. Production takes from the oldest lot first.

Supplier.purpose: A company the factory buys materials from.

columns.name: Supplier name.
columns.contact: Contact person or telephone (may be empty).
columns.address: Postal address, printed on the purchase order.
columns.active: False hides the supplier from new purchase orders; old ones stay.

SupplierMaterial.purpose: A material a supplier sells, with its price. One row per supplier and material.

columns.supplierId: The supplier. The row goes with the supplier when it is deleted.
columns.unitPrice: Initial unit price in yen; copied to a purchase order line, where it can be changed.

QtReference.purpose: A quotation (QT). Confirming it makes one production order.

columns.customerPoNumber: Number of the customer's purchase order (may be empty).
columns.customerPoDate: Date of the customer's purchase order.
columns.productionOrderId: The production order made by Confirm. Unique, so a QT makes only one order.

QtLine.purpose: A product line of a QT. One row per QT and product.

columns.qtId: The QT. The line goes with the QT when it is deleted.
columns.unitPrice: Unit price in yen. The amount (quantity x unit price) is computed, not stored.

ProductionOrder.purpose: The factory order made by Confirm QT. Its status (Draft, In Progress, Completed) is computed from its processes.

columns.orderNumber: Order number (ORD-yyyy-0001), given by the server. Unique.
columns.qtId: The QT it was made from.
columns.customerId: The customer, copied from the QT.
columns.startedAt: When production started. Empty before the start; after it the products and processes are locked.

OrderLine.purpose: A product line of a production order, copied from the QT line.

columns.orderId: The order. The line goes with the order when it is deleted.

OrderProcess.purpose: One manual step of making a line (cutting, assembly, testing, ...), in order.

columns.lineId: The order line. The process goes with the line when it is deleted.
columns.name: Name of the step.
columns.instructions: How to do the step (may be empty).
columns.completedQuantity: Quantity finished so far, from 0 up to the quantity of the line.

ProgressEntry.purpose: History of progress: every time a process is updated. Never changed or deleted.

columns.note: Note (needed when a Completed process is reopened).

Invoice.purpose: An invoice for a Completed order: a copy of the order as it was. One per order.

columns.orderId: The order. Unique, so an order is billed once.

InvoiceLine.purpose: A line of an invoice, with the product data copied when it was issued.

columns.invoiceId: The invoice. The line goes with the invoice.

Payment.purpose: The one full payment of an invoice.

columns.invoiceId: The invoice. Unique: one payment per invoice.
columns.amount: Amount in yen. Must equal the total of the invoice.

Receipt.purpose: The receipt issued when an invoice is paid.

columns.invoiceId: The invoice. Unique: one receipt per invoice.

PurchaseOrder.purpose: A purchase order (PO) to a supplier.

columns.department: Department the purchase is for (a plain list, not a permission).
columns.total: Sum of the line amounts, in yen.
columns.receivedAt: When the status became Received; the stock was added then, once.
columns.createdBy: The user who made the PO.

PurchaseOrderLine.purpose: A material on a purchase order. Lines change only while the PO is Draft.

columns.poId: The PO. The line goes with the PO when it is deleted.
columns.unitPrice: Unit price in yen; starts from the supplier's price.
columns.lotNumber: Lot typed for this line when the PO is received; the received quantity goes into it.

PurchasePayment.purpose: The one payment of a received purchase order. It does not go through the Accounting tables.

columns.poId: The PO. Unique: one payment per PO.
columns.amount: Amount in yen. Must equal the total of the PO.
columns.referenceNo: Reference number of the payment (may be empty).

StockChange.purpose: History of every change of a lot: by hand, by the start of an order, or by receiving a PO. Never changed or deleted.

columns.change: Signed quantity added to the lot (negative for a deduction).
columns.balance: Quantity of the lot after the change.
columns.initial: True for the first stock of a material; a material with a later change cannot be deleted.
columns.orderId: The production order whose start took the stock (if any).
columns.purchaseOrderId: The PO whose receiving added the stock (if any).
